name: webiny-admin-ui-extensions
description: Customizing the Webiny Admin UI -- white-labeling, custom data list columns, page-type forms, named dialogs, named drawers, and Lexical editor plugins. Use this skill when the developer wants to change branding (logo, title, theme colors), add custom columns to content entry list views, create custom forms for Website Builder page types, register named dialogs or drawers that can be opened from anywhere with params, or extend the Lexical rich text editor. Covers AdminConfig, ContentEntryListConfig, useDialog, useDrawer, useOpenDialog, useOpenDrawer.
